landing.title: CVs that look right in Hebrew and English
landing.subtitle: Write your CV once, switch templates instantly, and export a PDF where mixed Hebrew and English text, emails, phone numbers and dates stay in the right order.
landing.localFirst: Everything stays in your browser. No account needed.
landing.f1Body: Templates mirror correctly, and tokens like C++, GD&T or 05/2025 never get scrambled.
landing.f2Body: Edit on one side and see real pages on the other, exactly as they print.
landing.f3Body: Military service, Hebrew section titles and Israeli phone formats out of the box.
landing.f4Body: Stored locally in your browser, with full JSON backup and restore.
landing.templatesSubtitle: Ten original designs, each tested in Hebrew and English.

dashboard.emptyBody: Create your first CV from scratch, from the sample, or import a JSON file.
dashboard.emptyLettersBody: Cover letters arrive in phase 6. They will share the theme and header of a linked CV.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “<bdi>{title}</bdi>”?
deleteDialog.body: This removes the document and its version history from this browser. It cannot be undone. Consider downloading a JSON backup first.

editor.pageWarning: Longer than 2 pages. Most recruiters prefer one or two.
editor.previewHint: Click any part of the preview to jump to it in the form.

sections.title: Section title

fields.name: Full name

fields.phoneHint: Israeli numbers are formatted automatically, e.g. 052-1234567.
fields.photoHint: Photos are optional and uncommon in Israeli and English-language CVs. Shown only in templates that support a photo.
fields.photoUnsupported: The current template does not show a photo.
fields.extrasHint: Not required on Israeli CVs. Off by default.
fields.organizationHint: A general description is fine, e.g. “Defense industry company”.

fields.title: Title

history.description: Versions are saved automatically every 10 minutes while you edit. Save a named version before big changes.
history.namePlaceholder: e.g. Before tailoring for Company X

templates.title: Templates

writing.verbsHint: Click a word to copy it, then start a bullet with it. The second line is the same word in the other language.
writing.examplesHint: Add puts the example in as an editable bullet. Replace the [brackets] with your own details.
writing.summaryExamplesHint: Add puts the example at the end of your summary. Replace the [brackets] with your own details.
writing.added: Added. Replace the [brackets] with your own details.

hints.summaryShort: A bit short: add your main tools and the role you want.
hints.summaryLong: Long: recruiters skim, so keep it to 2–4 lines.

hints.asBullets: Bullets are easier to scan than a paragraph. Use the list button in the toolbar.

hints.bulletShort: Bullet {n} is very short. Add what you did and what came of it.
hints.bulletWeak: Bullet {n} starts with “{phrase}”. Start with an action word instead, such as {example}.
hints.paragraphWeak: Starts with “{phrase}”. Start with an action word instead, such as {example}.

review.intro: How complete your CV is. Fix the items below, starting from the top.
review.allDone: Everything on the checklist is done.
review.note: The score is a guide, not a grade: a short, focused CV can be better than one that ticks every box.

ats.title: ATS tools
ats.templateColumns: This template has two columns or graphic blocks. Some applicant-tracking systems read them in the wrong order; for online applications, an ATS-friendly template is safer.
ats.photo: Your photo is shown. ATS systems ignore photos, and many companies outside Israel prefer CVs without one.
ats.customTitles: Custom section titles: {titles}. Standard titles (Experience, Education, Skills) are easier for ATS systems to recognize.
ats.adPlaceholder: Paste the job description here (Hebrew or English)
ats.adHint: Kept in this browser only. Hebrew words match with or without prefixes (ב, ה, ו, ל, מ, ש, כ), plural endings and geresh.
ats.missingHint: Add the ones you really have, in the same spelling as the ad. + adds a tool to your skills.
ats.noKeywords: No keywords found yet. Paste the full job description.
ats.textHint: What an applicant-tracking system extracts: text only, in reading order.
